note: A game's pass from Elo Pros (meter/accounts.py, docs/client/ACCOUNTS.md §2): what a shard is handed instead of a wallet signature when a player is signed in to Elo Pros. Verify it offline: split on '.', base64url-decode both halves, check the ed25519 signature over the text's bytes against the account pubkey (GET /api/account/pubkey: standard base64 of 32 bytes), then that the text is exactly these seven lines, `for` is play:<your slug>, `shard` is a domain your shard signs in as, `nonce` is the one your shard handed this join (as SIWE's is), and `exp` is ahead. With a wallet the player is that wallet (lowercase); with `none` it is the account id. meter/test_accounts.py pins the minter to this file. The seed is a test key, sha256("elo account token fixture"), and signs nothing real.

with_wallet.text:
elo account
id: acct_0123456789abcdef0123
for: play:gates
shard: elopros.com
nonce: 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
wallet: 0x24445efddb08d4938e3e3627042b2cf4063d9092
exp: 1800000000

no_wallet.text:
elo account

for: play:gates

refused.another_shard: shard: evil.example — a pass a player handed some other server
refused.site: for: site — the site's own token, never a pass
refused.another_join: nonce: another — a pass replayed at a later join, even at the same shard
